name: Golden Goose

prices.note: US store (USD). Women's (548 products) and men's (346) sneaker grids read in full via ?start=0&sz=600; 881 unique items in /sneakers/ categories, every one with discount 0 and price = item_fullprice in the tile analytics. Boots, sandals and loafers excluded. Low: Yatay Model 1B sneakers $350; Super-Star from $580 (men's super-star in leather with black star); Ball Star from $595; high: Swarovski Francy, Forty2 and Slide Lab styles $2,520. Most common prices $695, $660, $790.

notes: Super-Star product page (women's, brown suede, $640): 'Lived-in effect', 'Handmade', 'Made in Italy'; footer: 'We like things that are lived-in, distressed, touched with life.' known_for paraphrases these.

Shipping page: standard delivery 3-5 working days; products ship 'from both our US warehouse and our headquarters in Italy'. No fee or free-shipping threshold stated, so free_shipping_min_usd left empty. Duties not mentioned.

Returns page: 'You can return any product purchased on goldengoose.com within 14 days from the date of delivery'; 'Making a return, whether online or in store, is free' (mail-return instructions also say the shipping cost is deducted from the refund).
Size guide: women's sneakers IT 34–42 = US 4–12; men's IT 39–50 = US 6–17. No fit advice per model.
Store locator lists 'Stores in United States' incl. Aspen (419 East Hyman Ave), Boston (Copley Place, 100 Huntington Ave), Chicago (40 E Oak St).

Wikipedia (Golden Goose Deluxe Brand): founded 2000 in Marghera near Venice by Alessandro Gallo and Francesca Rinaldo; HQ Milan since 2021; HSG (HongShan) bought a majority stake in December 2025, Temasek/True Light Capital minority. Footer: Golden Goose SpA, Via Privata E. Marelli 10, Milan.
